Constitutional AI uses written principles to guide critique/revision and preference judgments; RLAIF uses AI-generated feedback in training rather than relying entirely on human labels. This scales supervision but also transfers the judge's blind spots. [1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.08073)

To discourage sycophancy, include paired examples where a user confidently asserts a false premise and the correct response respectfully corrects it. Score factual support independently from politeness, verbosity, and agreement. Blind model identity and calibrate judges against human/executable checks. [2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.05685)

A written principle is not self-enforcing: monitor whether reward optimization learns superficial phrases rather than behavior. Use adversarial evaluations, independent reference evidence, and disagreement review. Keep the distinction between being helpful to a user and agreeing with every claim the user makes.
